Israeli Fire Kills Palestinians in Gaza and West Bank

Israeli fire resulted in the deaths of seven Palestinians in Gaza and one Palestinian in the West Bank. In Gaza, rescuers reported that Israeli fire killed seven individuals. In the West Bank, an Israeli firing incident led to the death of a Palestinian during a clash with settlers.
